fallacies.text: People in the comments were impressed, as the moment was proof the 'You're Still The One' singer wasn't lip-syncing.
fallacies.explanation: The comments rely on the emotional reaction and admiration of fans to support the claim that Shania Twain is singing live, rather than providing any technical evidence or expert verification.
This comment implies that because multiple fans believe Shania Twain is not lip-syncing, it must be true, appealing to the popularity of the opinion rather than factual evidence.
